title: Registration Process
heading: Membership Registration
intro: Become a member of Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation and contribute to building a financially inclusive, empowered, and self-reliant society. As a member, you will have the opportunity to participate in our social development initiatives, financial literacy programs, community welfare activities, and entrepreneurship support programs.
